about: Curated money paths for docs/DATA_FLOW_MAP.md. Each step names an exported Cloud Function. `watches` must equal the database path that function's trigger watches, and some earlier step (or `startsFrom`) must write that node. `writes` lists database nodes the step must still write. `npm test` checks all of this against the source scan, so a renamed path or function breaks the build instead of silently breaking the books. Edit this file, then run `npm run map:data-flow`.

flows.title: Till sale (POS Charge & Complete)
flows.summary: Every till sale, online or replayed after being offline, reaches the server once through `syncOfflinePosSale`. Everything after that is a reaction to the saved order record.

steps.note: Accepts the sale exactly once (client transaction id) and saves the authoritative order.
Posts revenue, tax and each tender as a balanced, immutable movement.
Deducts stock from the recipe plan and stamps `cogsSnapshot` on the order; lines with no usable recipe go to uncostedSales.
Projects each movement into the Finance Books journal; unmapped accounts go to books/reviewQueue.
Projects the order's COGS into the Finance Books journal.
Keeps the daily and monthly net totals the Books reports read.
Keeps the cash balance and cash-flow summaries current.
Credits Rewards points or stamps when a member is attached.

flows.showsIn: Admin Sales History and Daily Report (orders); inventory balances; Finance Books journal, P&L and Balance Sheet (books/journal and monthly net); Rewards member balance.
flows.ifBroken: follow the order id downstream: the /orders record (status, inventoryDeducted, cogsSnapshot), its /financialMovements, the /books/journal entry, then /books/reviewQueue for unmapped accounts. The first record that is missing points at the step that failed.

flows.title: Online and QR order (customer app)
flows.summary: The customer app creates the order; staff or the scheduler move it to completed. Posting then follows the same chain as a till sale.

steps.note: Server prices the order and saves it; the customer index is keyed by Firebase UID.
Staff accept the order.
Staff status changes, with transition history and idempotency.
Customer confirms receipt.
Scheduled every 15 minutes: completes ready orders nobody closed.
Posts the sale to the account the customer chose to pay into.
Deducts stock and stamps COGS.

flows.showsIn: Customer order tracking (customerOrders); live order cards (activeOrders); then the same reports as a till sale.
flows.ifBroken: check the order's status first; nothing posts until it is completed. Then follow the till-sale checks.

flows.title: Refund, void and order correction
flows.summary: A manager adjustment changes the order record; the posting and inventory triggers react with linked reversals rather than editing the original sale.

steps.note: Records the refund, void or correction; requests a stock return when restocking.
Posts a reversal for the refunded or voided amount, linked to the original sale.
Returns the stock the sale used and offsets its COGS; waits for finalization if the sale is still being costed.
Finance Books date repair: re-dates a void posted after its sale onto the sale date (net-zero reversal plus repost) and, when ticked, requests the stock return.
The same stock return for an order already archived; COGS reversal dated on the void accounting date.

flows.showsIn: Sales History refund/void columns; inventory balances; Finance Books journal and P&L.
flows.ifBroken: check the order's refundAmount, voided and inventoryReversed fields, then the reversal movements linked to the order id, then the journal.

flows.title: Shift close and cash custody
flows.summary: The Register screen writes the closed shift directly. Server triggers post the shift's cash into custody and record the close receipt.

steps.note: Moves the counted cash into the Undeposited Collection custody pool and posts the shift's movements.
Writes the tamper-evident close receipt and owner daily summary, flagging outstanding inventory or finance postings.
Posts register pay-ins.

flows.showsIn: Z report and Daily Report; Undeposited Collection; Finance Books cash accounts.
flows.ifBroken: compare the shift's zReport with /shiftCloseReceipts for that shift (status posting_follow_up lists what is outstanding), then the shift's movements and /cashCustody.

flows.title: Purchase, supplier bill and payment
flows.summary: Finance Books and the Admin Purchases screen post through one financial command; corrections go through a separate, controlled callable.

steps.note: Actions include purchase_paid, purchase_owner_funded, create_payable, pay_payable and reverse_payable_payment.
Amend or reverse a posted purchase with linked reversals.
Builds a single journal entry per purchase, using the purchase invoice for line detail.

flows.showsIn: Admin Purchases; Finance Books Payables and journal.
flows.ifBroken: start from the purchase invoice (PUR number), then its payable and payments, then the movements that cite it, then the journal entry.

flows.title: Cash payment voucher (petty cash)
flows.summary: A voucher is saved through a callable; a trigger on the voucher record posts it and allocates the cash from custody.

steps.note: Creates, corrects or reverses a cash payment voucher.
Posts the voucher and allocates the cash from the custody pool.

flows.showsIn: Cash Payments; Undeposited Collection; Finance Books expense and cash accounts.
flows.ifBroken: check the voucher's cashCustodyStatus and cashCustodyShortfall fields, then its movement, then the journal.

flows.title: GrabFood and FoodPanda payout
flows.summary: Platform sales post gross revenue and leave the expected net as a receivable until a payout is settled against matched orders.

steps.note: Settles a payout against matched orders only.
Reverses a settled payout with linked movements.

flows.showsIn: Platform payouts screen; Finance Books 1100 Accounts Receivable - Platforms and bank accounts.
flows.ifBroken: check the payout's matched orders and amounts, then its movements, then the journal.
